$comment: Briefs for tools/imagegen.mjs. style + kinds[kind].style + prompt are joined into one prompt. Change a brief, and the next run's variants carry a new brief hash in their log.
style: Original stylized game art for a dark, premium web app set in a post-apocalyptic survival world built from scrap. Semi-realistic 3D render with clean hard-surface modelling: worn painted metal, rust patina, rivets, bolts, scratched edges. Cool cyan rim light with a subtle violet accent, warm brass highlights. Crisp, high contrast, readable at small sizes, consistent lighting from the upper left. No text, letters, numbers or symbols with writing, no logos, no watermarks, no UI elements, no people's faces. Not in the style of any specific existing game; no recognizable trademarks or brand designs.

crate.style: A single object, centered, three-quarter view from slightly above, filling about 80 % of the frame, soft contact shadow directly under it, nothing else in the scene, transparent background.

tile.style: Moody graphite-black backdrop. Portrait game cover illustration. The subject sits in the lower two thirds; the top third is calm, dark, low-detail space for a title overlay. Edge-to-edge scene, cinematic depth of field.

banner.style: Moody graphite-black backdrop. Wide cinematic banner. The focal subject sits in the right half; the left 45 % is dark, low-detail negative space for a headline. Edge-to-edge scene.
